page.layout: One page of text; a title block at the top (full width); a large woodcut initial at the start of the body; short marginal notes in the right margin; a signature mark "A" centred at the foot.

main_text.head: COMMENTARII RERVM IN ECCLESIA GESTARVM, Maximarumq; per totam Europam persecutionum a VVicleni temporibus ad hanc usq; etatem descriptio, per Io. Foxum.
LIBER I.
main_text.p: ETSI ANTE VVICLEVI tempora nonnullos extitisse constat qui in eadem, in qua Vuicleus noster, causa palaestraq; elaborarunt, quos continuis temporibus spiritus sanctus nunquam excitare destitit in Ecclesijs, ad traducendos quotidie inualescētes seculi errores, in qua farragine censentur in historiarum monumentis Berengarius sub Berengarius. Henrico 3. imperatore, an. 1051. I. Scotus. & I. Scotus qui corporis & sanguinis ueritate auferebat Sacramento. Bruno. Bruno Andegauensis, Okleus secū dus, Valdeses, Marsilius de Padua. Okleus. Valdenses. Marsilius.

page.notes: The initial "E" is a woodcut initial and is read as E. Marginal notes are small and partly cut; the note words are reconstructed from the scan where the printing is faint. The opening words "ETSI ANTE VVICLEVI" are set in capitals with the initial letter joined to the body text. The running head is absent; the page carries no printed page number. Some marginal words ("Berengarius", "Okleus", "Valdenses") are read from fragmentary print and may be inexact.
